title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work in small teams and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. You'll be the technical bridge between Applied Intuition's novel vehicle intelligence platforms and our customers' real-world operational environments.

This role demands both technical depth and operational excellence. You'll work with customers, integrating our tools, Vehicle OS, and autonomy stacks in challenging operational environments. The unique advantage: you'll leverage our robust commercial technology and rapidly evolving product suite to deliver capabilities that would take traditional contractors years to develop. You'll tackle problems spanning core software engineering, system deployment, hardware integration, and everything in between to ensure mission success.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Work directly with customers to deploy, integrate, and operationalize Applied Intuition's vehicle intelligence products

- Tackle a broad range of technical challenges, including software engineering, operating system configuration, system deployment, and hardware integration

- Bridge customer-built systems and Applied’s solutions to deliver tangible value

- Design and implement scalable, consistent approaches for customer engagement and project execution

- Develop architectural solutions that improve consistency and scalability across projects

- Collaborate with internal engineering, product, and customer teams to ensure successful outcomes

- Take ownership of technical outcomes and drive projects to completion, adapting to changing requirements and priorities

We're looking for someone who has:

- Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering

- Strong engineer with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python

- Broad technical experience across software engineering, operating systems, and some hardware

- Experience supporting integration and deployment of complex systems

- Exceptional problem-solving skills and a proven ability to thrive and innovate independently within highly ambiguous and rapidly evolving operational environments

- Excellent communication skills and focus on solving customer problems

- Experience in driving customer engagements and success

- References who will describe them as low-ego, highly motivated, thoughtfully opinionated, strong communicators and curious listeners

Travel requirements:

- General willingness to travel for company business between our offices, as well as to customer sites

title: Core Strategy Senior Lead
locationText: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

The Core Strategy team reports directly to our CEO and is tasked with solving some of Faire’s most urgent and challenging problems. This can range from driving investment decisions on major expansion opportunities to directly owning pilot execution on high potential new bets. We operate at a wide range of altitudes and across all areas of the business.

You will be joining a small team with a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The work will vary project-to-project, but the throughline is that you will be taking ambiguous, complex problems, creating clarity, and then driving to impact. In many cases that will mean you are directly owning outcomes for high priority pilots or other initiatives. As an example, our team drove the decision to launch Faire Source and then played a central role in building the program from the ground up alongside a small cross-functional team.

This role combines strategic thinking, analytical rigor, product judgment, external & internal relationship-building, and the operational chops to get things done. We are looking for someone who is equally at home unpacking ambiguous board-level strategy questions as they are running a scrappy pilot. No matter the project, success in this role will always look like creating clarity and then seeing that clarity through to real-world impact.

What you’ll do 

• Take ambiguous, high-stakes problems from first framing through to implementation

• Break down complex questions from first principles, with a mix of analytical rigor, customer insight, and collaboration with internal and external experts

• Consistently raise the bar on how our team uses AI to get to better answers, faster

• Collaborate closely with the product, analytics, marketing, finance, and ops teams to solve problems and drive through execution to outcomes

• Spot cross-functional dependencies early and unblock them yourself

• Present your recommendations and debate their implications with Faire’s executive team, guiding key company decisions

• Help shape the culture and capabilities of the Core Strategy team by improving our processes, mentoring teammates, and setting a high bar for excellence

Qualifications

• A Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience across consulting, business operations, product, strategy, or analytics roles

• Exceptional problem solving skills and ability to identify and synthesize insights from data

• Deep analytical toolkit, with strong proficiency in Excel, SQL, and AI tools

• Executive-level communication skills, including the ability to use verbal and written communication to express ideas clearly and succinctly 

• Excellent at breaking down unstructured problems and synthesizing many disparate sources of information to deliver simple and thoughtful answers

• Strong business judgment, with ability to think across every dimension of the business 

• Experience with quantitative and qualitative consumer and market research techniques

• Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership

• Curiosity, low ego, and willingness to learn from a wide range of people

title: Principal Database Engineer
description:
Job Description:
The Principal Database Engineer (DBE) is a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture, automation, performance, and operational excellence of NextGen's enterprise database platforms supporting cloud-first healthcare applications. This role bridges deep database engineering with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to build highly available, scalable, secure, and observable data platforms across public cloud environments.

• Define, architect, evolve and govern highly available, resilient, and secure enterprise database platforms across cloud environments (AWS, GCP).

• Lead the reliability, performance, scalability, and lifecycle management of Microsoft SQL Server platforms while driving enterprise-wide migrations and modernization initiatives toward PostgreSQL and cloud-native database services.

• Design and develop automated frameworks for database provisioning, patching, backup validation, failover testing, and routine maintenance using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management.

• Partner with Platform Engineering to design and implement robust database release automation, CI/CD pipelines, schema versioning, and environment standardization.

• Collaborate with application development teams to optimize database design, query performance, schema evolution, and deployment strategies for cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.

• Establish comprehensive database observability standards, implementing telemetry, logging, proactive alerting, and performance analytics across all database environments.

• Define and improve database reliability objectives, recovery strategies, and operational readiness practices.

• Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent corrective actions following major database production incidents, establishing post-mortem reviews to mitigate future risks.

• Author enterprise engineering standards, reusable automation modules, and comprehensive technical documentation to reduce operational complexity and improve platform consistency.

• Align database technology roadmaps with business goals in partnership with engineering leadership.

• Continuously evaluate emerging databases and data-tier technologies to recommend architectural improvements that enhance long-term reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.

• Serve as the primary technical authority for database architecture and cloud migrations, mentoring junior and mid-level engineers while influencing technical strategy across the engineering organization.

• Support strategic cloud initiatives across AWS and Google Cloud while remaining cloud-provider agnostic wherever practical.

• Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

• Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

• 10+ years of experience designing, supporting, and managing enterprise relational database platforms in production, with extensive experience operating in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices.

• Experience participating in incident response, root cause analysis, SRE initiatives, and implementing database DevOps practices like schema versioning and release automation.

• Experience mentoring engineers, influencing enterprise technical standards, and driving legacy database migrations (such as SQL Server) to cloud-native or open-source platforms.

• Experience supporting cloud-native applications, Kubernetes, or containerized workloads, ideally within SaaS, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries (preferred).

License/Certification Required:

• Microsoft SQL Server certification or equivalent experience.

• AWS or Google Cloud Professional certification (preferred)

description:

title: Staff / Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) - Crawler
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the content acquisition and crawling infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building systems that discover, fetch, and continuously refresh content from the open web and other large-scale data sources. You will design distributed crawling, scheduling, and ingestion infrastructure capable of operating at internet scale while balancing coverage, freshness, resource efficiency, and reliability. You will work on systems that process billions of URLs, manage high-throughput data flows, and ensure that high-quality content is consistently available to downstream indexing and retrieval systems.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

• Design, implement, and operate web-scale crawling systems for acquiring content from the internet

• Build ingestion workflows for internal and external data sources, including crawlers, structured feeds, and partner integrations

• Develop crawl scheduling, prioritisation, recrawl policies, and freshness strategies

• Build systems for URL discovery, deduplication, content extraction, and crawl orchestration

• Ensure reliable operation of crawling infrastructure under high-throughput conditions

• Define observability and quality metrics for crawl coverage, freshness, throughput, and content quality

• Monitor resource usage, bandwidth consumption, and infrastructure cost

• Collaborate with indexing and ML teams to ensure acquired content meets retrieval and ranking requirements

• Enable safe experimentation with crawling strategies and content acquisition policies

You may be a good fit if you:

• 5+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems

• Strong Go or C++ expertise 

• Experience with large-scale distributed systems (10k+ RPS, billions of URLs, high-throughput pipelines)

• Understanding of web protocols (HTTP, DNS, TLS), crawling, scraping, and content extraction

• Experience operating production systems and debugging failures in distributed environments

• Strong understanding of scalability, fault tolerance, and resource management

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

• Web crawling

• Building streaming data pipelines and event-driven systems

• Kafka, Pulsar, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms

• Designing distributed schedulers, queues, and asynchronous processing systems

• Spark, Flink, Beam, or MapReduce

• Ad tech, social networks, search engines, or other large-scale content platforms

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.
Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative

title: Senior Software Developer in Test (SDET)
description:
Hey there! We're AKKO !

Our mission is to protect the devices the world relies on by relentlessly innovating to deliver an unparalleled digital insurance experience. AKKO enables partners and their end-users with modern and seamless protection solutions. We've become the #1 ranked provider in our space with industry- leading reviews and NPS scores.

With rapid growth and a fully remote team fueled by passion, innovation, and collaboration, we’re just getting started. Our investors-led by Mundi, Fika, and Pear-bring the same conviction that helped power companies like Doordash, Gusto, wefox, and Pipe.

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer in Test (SDET) to focus on our automation and manual testing of the suite of software products that we offer to customers. The candidate will be required to carry out tests to ensure the software we’re building addresses the business requirements and provides user friendly experience to our customers. The primary role is heavy on writing automated tests, maintaining them and triaging failures. This role will also include manual testing work for newer initiatives.
THE DAY-TO-DAY

• Define risk-based test plans and acceptance criteria in partnership with Product/Engineering; translate user stories into clear test cases.

• Build and maintain automated tests (Cypress/TypeScript preferred) across E2E, integration, and API layers; create reusable utilities/page objects and stabilize flaky tests.

• Implement and own CI/CD test gates (smoke/regression) with parallelization and clear pass/fail signals; track coverage and test health metrics.

• Perform targeted manual/exploratory testing for new features, edge cases, and UX flows; drive regression for critical paths.

• Create and manage test data, mocks/fixtures, and environment configurations to keep tests deterministic and fast.

• Coordinate with engineers to reproduce, triage, and debug issues using logs/metrics/trace tools; verify fixes and prevent regressions.

• Own post-deploy smoke testing and release sign-off for web apps and mobile apps; document results and risks.

• Continuously improve the QA/SDET toolchain and practices (coding standards, coverage goals, flake budgets, reporting dashboards).

WHAT MAKES YOU QUALIFIED

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Software or related field (advanced degrees a plus).

• 5+ years in software testing with strong grounding in functional/regression and modern test design techniques (BC, EP, pairwise, etc.).

• Hands-on experience testing web applications and mobile apps end-to-end, including UX/UAT and bug verification across browsers/devices.

• 3+ years focused on test automation, including designing scalable frameworks and CI integration.

This is a dynamic and exciting position as you will lead our highly diverse development efforts in a fast-paced digital marketing environment.
It is absolutely imperative that you have at least 5 years experience and meet the qualifications in this job description.
We are only hiring top-notch "cream-of-the-crop" talent!
JOB DESCRIPTION
We have internal resources for design, copywriting and content creation, but the right candidate will be very comfortable leading the development effort and providing overall technical expertise in all phases of digital marketing, including the following:

•
Corporate Website: Ongoing site development and enhancement of our website

•
Email Marketing: Listbuilding, content creation, optimization, analytics, API development

•
Social Media Marketing & Promotion: Content distribution, organic traffic, paid traffic, optimization, analytics, API development

•
Content Marketing: Content creation, internal organization/process, distribution

•
Paid Advertising: Tracking, reporting, API development

JOB REQUIREMENTS
We are looking for top talent, so you must have the following skill sets (specifically in a digital marketing environment):

•
Expert level experience implementing Wordpress plugins, CSS, themes, templates, customization and API integration

•
Expert level experience implementing PHP, SQL, CSS, HTML and databases

•
Expert level experience implementing and deploying APIs

•
Proven ability working with tracking systems, analytics, conversion/pixel/postback tracking, and reporting

•
Proven ability in researching, recommending and implementing solutions to meet project requirements

•
Ability to manage multiple projects (with support from our full-time Filipino Project Manager)

title: Founding Operations Engineer (Legal)
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

- We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

- We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

- Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

- The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

- We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

- The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it.

- You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work.

- This is a legal role with heavy operational involvement and a requirement to build things. It is not a legal counsel role. You'll be qualified, you'll be able to act as counsel on day to day deal legals, but you'll sit close to the work and focus on streamlining / automating the systems generating the work in the first place.

- We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Microsoft Word or Docusign.

What you'll own

- Post-close and deal legals: You’ll own post-close: governance events, transfers, secondaries, distributions and exits. There is huge surface area for automation here too. You’ll also take care of the unusual issues where our documentation doesn't cleanly answer a question.

- Legal Reviews & Escalations: Every legal escalation coming out of the operations team.

- Automation: You'll work alongside the deal operations team, with a standing instruction to automate their work. You'll bring product/design/engineering into the things that genuinely need significant engineering work, but you’ll mainly work autonomously without them. Before it gets to them you've already made the process as simple and fast as possible, and usually vibe coded something that works well but perhaps needs to be stabilised / scaled.

- Managing external counsel: You’ll help decide what stays in-house, what goes out, and hold external advisers to account on cost and turnaround.

What we're looking for

- AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more.

- Qualified, with real deal legals experience: Funds, corporate, or financial services.

- In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard

title: Process Manager (Last Mile)
description:
At Rohlik, we own our end-to-end operations - from in-house technology and automated distribution centers to last-mile delivery. Delivering over 20,000 fresh and supermarket products same-day requires an operating model built on precision, cutting-edge automation, and data-driven decision-making.

As a Process Manager, Operations, you will be at the heart of optimizing and scaling this operational model across Central and Eastern Europe. You’ll sit right between business operations and product development, turning operational challenges into structured, high-performing processes and scalable technical solutions.

This is an analytical, highly hands-on role. You won’t just produce theoretical diagrams - you will spend time on the floor, analyze workflow data, design detailed process specifications for software developers, and ensure seamless rollouts across our multi-country fulfillment network.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-impact transformation: You will directly shape how our last-mile logistics operate as we scale across five European markets.

- Tech and automation focus: Work in an environment leveraging advanced warehouse automation, robotics, AI-driven decision systems, and autonomous last-mile delivery.

- Bridge operations and tech: Turn real-world fulfillment center friction into actionable engineering specifications and product roadmaps.

- Build for scale: Standardize methodologies across multiple sites while ensuring solutions are robust enough for rapid international expansion.

- Direct ownership: See the immediate operational impact of your work in metrics like cycle time, cost-per-order, and fulfillment accuracy.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Process Analysis & Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and root causes across fulfillment center and last-mile operations.

- Process Design & Specification: Develop and document detailed target process designs, translating business requirements into technical specs for Product Owners and developers.

- Methodological Improvement: Apply Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC, VSM, and Ishikawa frameworks to streamline operational workflows.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Owners, software developers, engineering, and local operational teams to validate, test, and implement solutions.

- Business Case & KPI Tracking: Define process KPIs, build business cases (ROI, budgets, timelines), and track the measurable impact of improvements post-rollout.

- Implementation & Readiness: Write SOPs, prepare change management documentation, and support site teams to ensure smooth process rollouts.

- Continuous Improvement: Feed field insights into continuous improvement roadmaps and strategic operational initiatives.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 2-3 years of experience in operations, process engineering, or JIT logistics within fast-paced environments (e-commerce, retail, automotive, or 3PL).

- Strong process toolbox: Hands-on mastery of methodologies and tools like VSM, DMAIC, Ishikawa, and SIPOC.

- Data-driven mindset: Strong analytical skills paired with advanced Excel capabilities (pivot tables, complex formulas) to evaluate KPIs and drive decisions.

- Tech-translating ability: Proven experience translating operational business requirements into clear process documentation for software engineering teams.

- Solid documentation skills: Experience producing clear SOPs, training materials, and change management frameworks.

- Language skills: English proficiency at B2 level minimum (written and spoken).

- Flexibility to travel: Willingness to travel up to 50% across our operational sites in 5 countries (Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, Romania).

Nice-to-haves:

- Lean Six Sigma certification (Green/Black Belt).

- Working knowledge of SQL, BI tools, or statistical analysis software.

- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with software development teams.

- Familiarity with warehouse automation, robotics, or automated logistics systems.

title: AI Researcher — AI Architecture Research
description:
About the Role
We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on AI architecture research to help design, analyze, and advance next-generation model architectures. You’ll work at the intersection of theory and production-publishing novel research while collaborating closely with engineers to turn ideas into real systems.
This role is ideal for someone who has published research papers and wants to see their work directly shape deployed models, not just benchmarks.
What You’ll Work On

• Research and design novel AI architectures (e.g. alternatives to standard Transformer designs, long-context models, efficient sequence modeling, hybrid architectures)

• Explore architectural improvements for scalability, efficiency, and stability

• Prototype and evaluate new architectures through ablations, benchmarks, and empirical studies

• Collaborate with engineering teams to translate research into training and inference systems

• Stay current with state-of-the-art research and identify promising directions early

What We’re Looking For

• Strong background in machine learning research , with a focus on model architecture

•
Deep understanding of:

• Neural network architectures

• Sequence models and attention mechanisms

• Training dynamics and optimization

• Hands-on experience with PyTorch or JAX

• Ability to reason rigorously, design clean experiments, and communicate results clearly

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

• Experience with non-Transformer architectures (e.g. RNN-based, state-space, hybrid models)

• Work on long-context or memory-efficient models

• Open-source research contributions

• Experience bridging research and production systems

• Background in efficient training or inference-aware architecture design

Why Join Us

• High ownership over research direction and roadmap

• Clear path to publishing impactful work

• Tight feedback loop between research and real-world deployment

• Small, highly technical team with strong research culture

• Competitive compensation and meaningful equity

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content and events. Two engines of Flock's marketing, and you own the execution of both.

Today the marketing team is one Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the brand and website, publishes the content, launches the products and runs up to nine events a year, getting it all out of the door by pushing AI hard. We're doubling the team and backing it with 3.5x the budget.

You're the second person in, owning events and content.

Events. You'll plan the calendar with the Senior Marketing Manager and own delivery: trade shows and conferences, plus our own broker and customer events. On each one you'll set the budget, build the stand, run the day, chase the leads and report on whether it was worth repeating.

Content. You'll shape the strategy with the Senior Marketing Manager, then produce it. Volume and quality both count. LinkedIn and the Flock blog are the priorities, plus video and website copy. The stories sit with underwriting, distribution and product, so getting good material out of busy people is a big part of the job.

AI. Flock runs on AI and we build AI products for customers too. Marketing is held to the same standard. We want you to be the person who brings the newest tool into the office and shows everyone what it does. Brokers and customers still respond to work that feels human, so you'll be someone who writes excellently and still has creative flair.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own social media. Run our social strategy, with LinkedIn as the primary channel: product videos, carousels, infographics, and PDF’s, posted consistently and measured for engagement.

- Create content at volume. Case studies, articles, industry news, thought leadership and product launch material, several times a month.

- Make video. Film and produce videos with our team in and around the office: people stories, product walkthroughs and interviews.

- Deliver events. Work with the Senior Marketing Manager Coordinate and execute our calendar of seven to nine events a year: trade shows, conferences and our own customer and broker events.

- Design your own assets in Claude Design and Figma, to a standard that holds up next to agency work.

- Work with AI daily. Draft, edit, repurpose and scale content with AI tools, applying your own voice and judgement so nothing reads machine-written.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Significant content creation and social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, with measurable results from owning and executing a social strategy.

- A portfolio of work you can share on the spot.

- Strong copywriting and communication, proven in published work.

- A track record organising and coordinating trade shows, conferences or business events, plus internal events for customers and stakeholders.

- Hands-on design skills in Figma and Claude Design. Adobe Creative Cloud would be a bonus.

- Startup pace and ownership: you've worked somewhere small enough to own outcomes end to end, spot what needs improving and act without waiting for a brief.

- Confident, critical use of AI across your marketing work.

Nice to have: video editing experience, and exposure to insurance, fleet or telematics.

title: Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) - Lakeland, FL

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

This is an strategic individual contributor role for someone who combines finance and controls expertise with a strong affinity for process, data, and technology. You will act as a central orchestrator across the Record organization, partnering with functional managers and senior stakeholders to manage cross-team projects, establish delivery metrics, and consolidate reconciliation goals and performance.

The role is designed for someone who can operate autonomously, bring structure to ambiguous agendas, and lead through influence without direct people-management responsibility. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

- A degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Adm

description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

title: Mining Package Coordinator
description:
The Package Coordinator supports the coordination, procurement, and delivery of equipment and material packages for mining projects. Responsibilities:
Package Coordination

• Coordinate the development and execution of equipment and material packages from procurement through delivery.

• Maintain package schedules, trackers, and status reports to monitor progress and key milestones.

• Coordinate technical, commercial, and project requirements across engineering, procurement, vendors, and construction teams.

• Track package deliverables, approvals, outstanding actions, and required documentation.

• Identify potential delays, scope changes, and issues and escalate them to the appropriate project team members.

Engineering & Vendor Coordination

• Coordinate the flow of technical information between engineering teams and vendors.

• Distribute specifications, drawings, datasheets, and other technical documentation to relevant stakeholders.

• Track vendor document submissions, engineering reviews, comments, and approvals.

• Coordinate responses to vendor technical queries and Requests for Information (RFIs).

• Assist with resolving technical and commercial interfaces between equipment packages and other project disciplines.

Procurement Support

• Support the preparation and administration of Requests for Proposals (RFPs), purchase orders, and procurement documentation.

• Coordinate with procurement to monitor package status from bid through award, manufacturing, inspection, and delivery.

• Assist with bid evaluations and maintain procurement comparison and tracking information.

• Monitor vendor commitments and ensure required documentation and deliverables are received in accordance with purchase order requirements.

• Coordinate with suppliers to maintain delivery schedules and address outstanding requirements.

Schedule & Cost Tracking

• Maintain package schedules and monitor progress against project milestones.

• Track procurement activities, engineering deliverables, manufacturing progress, inspections, and delivery dates.

• Support package cost tracking and identify changes that may impact project budgets.

• Prepare regular package status updates and reports for project management and project controls.

• Maintain action item and risk registers for assigned packages.

Logistics & Delivery

• Coordinate equipment and material delivery requirements with vendors, procurement, logistics, and site teams.

• Track manufacturing, inspection, shipment, and delivery milestones.

• Assist with coordinating site delivery requirements and documentation.

• Support the resolution of delivery issues, delays, and discrepancies.

Documentation & Quality Assurance

• Maintain accurate and organized package documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Ensure required vendor documentation is complete, current, and properly distributed.

Interdisciplinary Coordination

Le département SRCD est composé de 24 enseignant.e.s-chercheurs.euses permanent.e.s, plus de 10 post-doctorant.e.s et ingénieur.e.s contractuel.le.s, et 30 doctorant.e.s. Ses domaines d'activité recouvrent tous les aspects de l'enseignement et de la recherche en systèmes et réseaux au sens large, en cybersécurité, et en droit et économie des activités numériques. Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche, la personne recrutée rejoindra l’équipe SOTERN (Self Protecting the Future Internet) du département D2 du laboratoire IRISA (UMR CNRS 6074), l'un des plus grands laboratoires de recherche français (+ de 850 personnes) dans le domaine de l'informatique et des nouvelles technologies de l'information.

Enjeux et profil attendu sur le thématique de recherche

Deux enjeux majeurs présentent actuellement un impact conséquent sur la recherche et l’innovation en Cybersécurité. D’un côté, l’intelligence artificielle par ses développements récents et les attendus pour les années à venir décuple les possibilités offertes aux attaquants pour mettre en œuvre de nouvelles attaques, tout autant qu’aux structures défensives (type SOC par exemple) pour détecter, corréler et contrer des incidents de sécurité. D’un autre côté, les cibles des attaques évoluent et les architectures déployées dans les réseaux opérationnels (systèmes industriels, réseaux intra-véhiculaires, avionique, opérateurs d’importance vitale) nécessitent de nouveaux moyens de détection et protection face à une menace grandissante.

Le profil recherché pour ce poste s’inscrit ainsi dans la thématique de la sécurité des réseaux au sens large. Il sera plus spécifiquement recherché soit une expertise relative aux architectures, protocoles et algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour la sécurité des réseaux ou de l’IA (apprentissage fédéré, sécurité des architectures d’IA type Model Context Protocol (MCP), etc.), soit une expertise sur la sécurité des réseaux opérationnels (OT) quel qu’en soit le cadre applicatif.

Enjeux et profil attendu en enseignement

Positionnée sur 3 campus attractifs, IMT Atlantique affiche une forte dynamique internationale tout en restant à taille humaine. Dans ces différents cursus BAC+5 (formations d’ingénieurs et de masters-DNM), les étudiants sont confrontés, via des approches pédagogiques variées, à des situations-problèmes concrets. L’école a ainsi pour ambition de former de jeunes professionnels à fort potentiel, capables de mobiliser un large spectre de compétences en situation réelle, dans des environnements (production, recherche, création d’activité, etc.) et des domaines socio-économiques variés.

Impliqué tant en tronc commun que dans les parcours électifs, la personne recrutée contribuera aussi bien dans sa spécialité Cybersécurité que dans des activités transverses, interdisciplinaires ou en lien avec des entreprises : tutorat de projets / stages, soutenances, accompagnement, etc. La personne recrutée sera encouragée à contribuer, dans un esprit de collaboration, à l’évolution cohérente des programmes d’études, en proposant de nouveaux projets, programmes et méthodologies pédagogiques, particulièrement inspirés et soutenus par les exigences et les partenariats industriels. https://www.imt-atlantique.fr/fr/formation

En cohérence avec le profil de la personne candidate, il sera demandé de prendre en main les thématiques d’enseignement parmi les suivantes : IA et Cybersécurité (IA offensive, IA pour la protection des infrastructures, sécurité de l’IA), Sécurité des systèmes industriels, participation puis prise de responsabilité de l’organisation d

- Strong attention to detail with a bias toward ownership and execution

- Excellent communication and presentation skills

- High intellectual curiosity and interest in AI / infrastructure / developer tooling

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills; familiarity with SQL or BI tools is a plus

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with GPU compute economics or cloud infrastructure

- Familiarity with how ML model training and fine-tuning work

- Experience with product-led growth economics, such as free tiers, credits, and conversion

- Experience pricing or launching a new product line

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

- Paid parental leave

title: Model Governance Lead, Credit
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We drive the evolution of Model Governance for Plaid’s Credit products. We work closely with Plaid’s Credit insights team, including Product, Data Science, and Engineering, to support the development and responsible use of next-generation Credit scores and attributes based on cash flow and Plaid’s network.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Model Governance Lead, Credit, you will own and execute the Model Governance program for Plaid’s Credit products. You will help ensure that the models supporting Plaid’s Credit Score and Insights products are conceptually sound, appropriately validated, well-documented, and fit for their intended use.

You will work independently while partnering closely with model owners and cross-functional stakeholders. You will provide thoughtful challenge, identify risks and limitations, and help teams improve models and governance practices over time.

WHAT EXCITES YOU

- Building and evolving a model risk governance framework for an important Credit product portfolio.

- Independently assessing the conceptual soundness, data, features, performance, stability, and intended use of credit models.

- Identifying model weaknesses and translating them into clear, actionable remediation plans.

- Partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to strengthen model development and validation practices.

- Creating clear, rigorous documentation that helps customers understand and trust the models behind Plaid’s Credit products.

- Bringing curiosity, sound judgment, and constructive challenge to complex modeling decisions.

- Helping shape responsible use of machine learning as Plaid develops new Credit scores and attributes.

WHAT EXCITES US

- 7+ years of experience building and owning a model governance program.

- Experience in model validation, model risk management, model development, or Data Science.

- Deep knowledge of models built for credit purposes.

- Strong understanding of machine learning modeling concepts and techniques, such as XGBoost, and what constitutes rigorous, defensible model validation.

- Familiarity with newer modeling techniques, such as foundation models and neural networks.

- Experience assessing data and feature inputs, conceptual soundness, model performance, stability, limitations, and appropriateness of use.

- A genuinely independent, detail-oriented, and curious mindset.

- Comfort providing meaningful challenge to model owners and stakeholders rather than simply documenting their work.

- Experience working at a FinTech is a plus.

title: Senior Commercial Counsel
description:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Senior Commercial Counsel to join us as the first commercial lawyer at Modal. This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to draft and negotiate a wide variety of commercial agreements and build the templates, playbooks, and positions that guide our operations. You'll report to our General Counsel and collaborate closely with the Sales, BizOps, Finance and Engineering teams and help build the foundation for a small but growing legal team.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own customer contracting, including MSAs, service orders, NDAs, DPAs, and BAAs - negotiating directly with customers and partnering with the Sales team throughout the full deal cycle

- Lead vendor-side contracting, including capex procurement, SaaS tools, and consulting arrangements, among others

- Build and maintain contract repositories, template libraries and contract playbooks

- Partner with Legal operations on CLM management, including approval workflows and escalation logic

- Review and revise operational policies, including terms of service, privacy policy, acceptable use, and website terms, and customer-facing marketing materials

REQUIREMENTS:

- 8+ years of combined law firm and in-house experience negotiating commercial technology agreements, with meaningful time supporting an enterprise sales motion

- JD and active membership in good standing in New York or California

- Deep familiarity with SaaS contracting

- Extensive experience working within Ironclad or a similar CLM

- Ability to build templates and playbooks from scratch

- Working knowledge of privacy and regulatory data protection frameworks, such as GDPR and HIPAA

- Sound commercial judgment: you know how to balance risk with the business needs of a high-growth tech company

BONUS:

- Experience with infrastructure, compute, or datacenter supply agreements

ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Commercial Field Engineer’s primary role is to serve as a technical advisor and champion for CodeRabbit customers in the Commercial tier throughout their post-sales journey. In this function, you will play a crucial role in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing success by partnering with Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Support teams to ensure customers realize the full value of CodeRabbit.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Lead onboarding and implementation engagements for commercial and mid-market customers

- Help customers configure and optimize CodeRabbit within their development workflows and CI/CD environments

- Stay current on emerging trends in AI-powered development tools, developer productivity, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD ecosystems

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

- 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Technical Support Engineering, Technical Account Management, or Implementation Engineering

- Experience onboarding or supporting SaaS, developer tooling, or infrastructure products

- Strong technical knowledge of software development workflows and modern engineering tools

- Comfortable troubleshooting APIs, integrations, Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-based systems

- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

What You Will Own

-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.
It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

Job Summary

Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Power and Performance Validation Lead will drive validation strategy and execution for advanced AI compute silicon and systems. The Power and Performance Validation team sits within the Architecture and Validation organisation and is responsible for validating the performance, efficiency and thermal behaviour of Graphcore silicon and systems.

Engineers work closely with cross-functional teams globally to debug complex issues, optimize workloads and continuously improve validation infrastructure and methodologies.

• Guide development of custom workload generators and micro-benchmarks where required

• Contribute to continuous improvement of validation processes, tooling and engineering practices

• Communicate technical findings, project status, risks and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and engineering leadership

• Support knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement across the validation organisation

Candidate Profile

Essential:

• Strong experience in power and performance validation, silicon characterization or system performance engineering

• Deep understanding of modern SoC architecture, including CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O technologies

• Strong Linux systems knowledge and low-level perfo

title: Product Manager Data & Collectors

Sobre Tendios

👋 Somos Tendios , una startup de rápido crecimiento nacida en 2023 en el corazón de Barcelona. Nuestra misión es revolucionar el mundo de la contratación pública para empresas e instituciones.
Nuestra plataforma SaaS impulsada por inteligencia artificial ayuda a empresas a ganar más licitaciones y a entidades públicas a crear y gestionar licitaciones de forma más eficiente. Trabajamos con entidades como el Principado de Asturias, Renfe, Acciona o Telefónica, entre otras. Lo hacemos a través de dos productos:

• Tendios Bid - para empresas que participan en licitaciones públicas: buscador, alertas, pipeline de oportunidades y workflows para ganar más concursos.

• Tendios Create - para organizaciones públicas que crean y publican licitaciones: creación de expedientes y redacción de pliegos asistida por IA.

La IA no es un añadido en nuestros productos: es el núcleo. Redacción asistida, propuestas generadas, análisis automático de documentos y flujos conversacionales están en el centro de la experiencia. Buscamos a alguien que diseñe con esa mentalidad, no alrededor de ella.
Como un equipo joven y ambicioso, valoramos la energía, la creatividad y la colaboración. Si te apasiona la innovación y quieres tener un impacto real, nos encantaría que te unas a nosotros para redefinir cómo las empresas optimizan sus procesos de licitación pública.
El rol
Buscamos a alguien que sea el dueño de producto de todo el ciclo del dato: desde que se captura en la fuente (collectors) hasta que llega al cliente como valor (listas, directorios, análisis de mercado y Tender Intelligence).
Es un rol híbrido: lidera un equipo técnico de scraping/collectors y, al mismo tiempo, define y entrega la capa de producto de analítica de mercado que usan los clientes de Bid. Es un puesto con mucho impacto directo: la calidad del dato condiciona la activación, la retención y la propuesta de valor de Tendios .

1. Gestión del equipo de Collectors

• Liderar y priorizar el trabajo del equipo de collectors (licitaciones, legislación, resoluciones y otras fuentes de contratación pública).

• Definir el roadmap de cobertura: nuevas fuentes, nuevos países/territorios, nuevos tipos de documento y mayor profundidad de campos.

• Evaluar la viabilidad y el valor de cada fuente (campos disponibles, frecuencia de actualización, estabilidad, coste de mantenimiento) antes de comprometer trabajo.

• Gestionar el backlog, el ritmo de entrega y la coordinación con Ingeniería y Data & AI.

• Garantizar la operación: monitorización de collectors, respuesta ante roturas de fuentes, SLAs de frescura y cobertura.

• Dar visibilidad al resto de la empresa sobre qué datos tenemos, con qué calidad y qué limitaciones.

2. ETL y Data Quality a nivel de producto

• Definir qué significa "dato de calidad" para Tendios : completitud, exactitud, consistencia, frescura, deduplicación y normalización.

• Establecer métricas y umbrales de calidad (por fuente, por país, por campo) y hacerles seguimiento con dashboards y alertas.

• Priorizar las mejoras del ETL en función del impacto en el producto: enriquecimiento, normalización de entidades (organismos y empresas), clasificación (CPV, tipologías, estados) y resolución de duplicados.

• Traducir problemas de calidad de dato en impacto de negocio (ruido en alertas, resultados irrelevantes, análisis incorrectos) y escalarlos con criterio.

• Definir la política de ciclo de vida del dato: estados de licitación, cambios, modificaciones, adjudicaciones y formalizaciones.

• Ser el punto de referencia para evaluar la readiness de nuevos mercados en términos de calidad y disponibilidad de datos.

3. Producto de analítica de mercado y oportunidades de cliente

•
Ser el dueño de producto de:

• Analítica interna de las oportunidades de las empresas

• Directorios de empresas y de entidades públicas.

• Tender Intelligence : análisis de mercado, competencia, comportamiento de compradores, históricos de adjudicación y detec
